title: Two new fast paths for text generation
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: more text models, sturdier image requests, and a much tidier path through Enter.

Claude Sonnet 4.5 is now available as claude-large, and Grok 4 Fast joined the model roster. DeepSeek V3.1 also moved to its OpenAI-compatible endpoint, because model APIs apparently enjoy changing shape.

Image requests now retry after service-side 500s, Seedream can fetch and convert reference images correctly, and enter.pollinations.ai received image caching. Fewer mysterious failures; less waiting for pixels.

Authentication is being consolidated under enter.pollinations.ai, registry changes now trigger Enter deployments, and auth-tier synchronization got its own script. Kontext requests are also routed through Enter, keeping the account and model-access path in one place.
